Her uniquely brief forensic statement amid long confessional defenses creates a substantial authorial giveaway. Evidence supports her lead independently, but conspicuous writing reinforces it.
Foil is non-unique: Chip, Dada, and Minnie have matching stock. Their absence from the walkthrough is not established; there is no unique torn-edge fit.
Most final accounts explain unrelated wrongdoing rather than alibi the murder. Corroborated innocence of one act does not exclude poisoning.
Four first-arrival records exclude source access cleanly, but repeating first admission twice in each speech sounds artificially corrective.
Real mounting failure explains relocation; payment dispute opens unattended-glass interval; independent circuits separate blackout from camera. Causal mechanics are coherent.
Thirty donor-coercion grievances and simultaneous salon confrontations feel engineered. Individually the wrongdoings and disputes are understandable.
Poison transfer remains under-described: no delivery tool, container, observed opening, poison residue on Claire's folder, or uniquely fitted band scrap.
No early checkpoint singled out Claire. Crucial combined trace/access facts arrive in the final release, avoiding early giveaway but concentrating the solution late.
